messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: INC-18250 triggered by alert 'embedder-eu-queue-depth > 500' — severity: P1 — routed to on-call. Links: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-18250 :rotating_light:
sam.kaplan: acked via PagerDuty. I'm on it, joining bridge. Anyone already digging?
anya: I saw some noisy retries in the metrics dashboard ~15m ago, could be autoscaler thrash.
mike: @sam.kaplan i'm still mid-deploy but can stand by to take handoff if you want to focus on customers.
sam.kaplan: thanks @mike. I'll start triage, pls stand by. first quick checks: runbook v3 -> https://redwood.runbooks/embed-queue.md  (follow section "fast drain + temp routing")
ops_lead: ping on customer impact? any customers affected yet?
sam.kaplan: early signals: elevated 5xx for a handful of embed requests, error rate ~1.8% (normal <0.1%). Traffic spike from eu region. Notified support to block new onboarding jobs.
anya: checking autoscaler logs now. snippet:
```
2026-03-17T12:45:03Z autoscaler: scale_down skipped due to pending_kv_evictions=24
2026-03-17T12:46:11Z router: retries=12 host=embedder-eu-2
```
Looks like concurrent evictions + retries causing request pileup.
sam.kaplan: good catch. Temporary mitigation: 1) disable aggressive scale-down window for embedder pools in EU; 2) enable fallback routing to dedicated pool eu-hot if health ok. I'll toggle both.
mike: I'll prepare the rollback and watch for regressions. tagging @ops_lead for customer comms.
ops_lead: noted. Please post ETA for safe window and whether to open a customer-facing status page entry.
sam.kaplan: ETA ~10m to flip policies and validate. If errors drop under 0.5% we'll keep mitigations; else escalate to infra. Creating incident bridge: meet at https://meet.example/bridge/INC-18250
anya: mitigation step 1 done: scale-down window extended to 10m on eu-embed pools. Monitoring.
incidentbot: action recorded: config change by anya at 1825010105 — note: change requires 2m for effect.
sam.kaplan: routing fallback applied to eu-hot pool at 1825010180. Observing tail latency and 5xx.
anya: metrics: error rate falling to 0.6% and queue depth down from 620 -> 210 over last 3m.
mike: nice. I'll keep watch and keep deploy halted until we confirm stability.
ops_lead: customer-impact decision: create status page incident with note 'Intermittent embedding errors for EU region, mitigation in progress. No customer data loss.' I'll draft and post after we confirm stable for 10m.
sam.kaplan: agreed. If stable for 10m we'll close P1 and document root cause as autoscaler+eviction interplay. Otherwise escalate to infra-runner.
anya: quick note for postmortem: include KV eviction thresholds and routing backpressure heuristics.
incidentbot: PagerDuty INC-18250 acknowledged by sam.kaplan at 1825010202.
ops_lead: thanks team. status pings every 5m. last update here at 1825010300.
